name: Skoogmusic Skwitch
description: Accessible single-button musical accessory used with an iPhone app.

documentation.title: Skoogmusic Skwitch: manufacturer or original documentation

notice: Skwitch requires its compatible phone and companion app; route the app MIDI output to your instrument. The accessory itself is not a USB MIDI controller. Musical behavior and MIDI assignments are app-dependent. Hardware is no longer sold or supported; check compatibility before obtaining used hardware. Use the software routing described above. Port names are intentionally empty: interface or app names do not reliably identify the attached hardware. Select this profile manually. This is partial coverage, not a complete MIDI implementation. The panel is an original schematic; virtual keyboard note numbers are illustrative and require MIDI learn or octave adjustment.
